summary: Feed c039_nic_crc is degraded: VF-1 port 3 input is corrupting frames with CRC/alignment errors (0.47% damaged) and IDS eth1 is discarding 0.58% of received packets due to capture overload. IDS is receiving incomplete and corrupted traffic, reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Physical layer fault on VF-1 port 3 (input) - 12,360 damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors (0.004669 > 1e-05 threshold) indicates faulty cable, bad optic/SFP, dirty fiber, or duplex mismatch on the link into the packet broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS receives corrupted frames that fail FCS and are dropped or mis-decoded; TCP reassembly and signature matching fail, causing missed detections, false negatives and gaps in flow reconstruction.

recommended_fix.why: Fix L1 errors at source before any broker processing - inspect/replace cable/optic, clean fiber, verify speed/duplex autoneg on both ends, check error counters clear to zero.

findings.root_cause: IDS eth1 capture interface overrun - tool discarded 15,240 packets (0.58% loss, threshold 0.1%) because its 1Gbps capture path could not keep up with the feed rate. Not a broker drop but end-tool overload.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with needs_both_directions and needs_full_payload loses random packets/flows; stateful detection, file extraction and alerting are incomplete, attacker traffic can evade detection due to missing packets.

recommended_fix.why: Reduce load to what IDS can handle: tune IDS capture (AF_PACKET/DPDK, ring buffers, pinning), filter to relevant traffic, or load-balance across multiple IDS instances/sensors, or upgrade to higher capture capacity NIC.
